name: 24523 · Bedford, VA
findings: ZIP 24523 (Bedford) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24523 (Bedford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24523 (Bedford) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
